nodes.name: Config Manager
nodes.business_intent: Library of channel configs (rate limits, quiet hours, sender identities) grouped by channel type.
nodes.extensibility: New config groups register a schema; no change to the library.

nodes.name: ConfigLibrary
nodes.business_intent: Add, delete, and resolve configs for a channel.

nodes.name: ConfigRepository
nodes.extensibility: Ports and adapters; swap the storage adapter.

nodes.name: SqliteConfigRepository
nodes.business_intent: SQLite adapter for the config port.

nodes.name: ChannelConfig
nodes.business_intent: Rate limit, quiet hours, retry policy and sender identity for a channel.

nodes.name: Dispatch Engine
nodes.business_intent: Loads channel plugins, delivers each message on the channels a subscriber wants, and enforces rate limits.

nodes.name: Channel
nodes.business_intent: Plugin contract every delivery channel implements.
nodes.extensibility: Strategy; a new channel = a new plugin file.

nodes.name: RoutingRule
nodes.business_intent: Decides whether a message may go out on a channel now.

nodes.name: PluginLoader
nodes.business_intent: Resolve channel type -> plugin class from plugins.json.

nodes.name: Dispatcher
nodes.business_intent: Delivers each message on its channels and enforces the per-recipient rate limit.

nodes.name: Event Intake
nodes.business_intent: Business events from upstream systems (webhooks in production, simulated in development) and subscription filtering.
nodes.extensibility: EventSource port; webhook and simulator adapters.

nodes.name: SimulatedEventSource
nodes.business_intent: Simulated event traffic for development and load tests.

nodes.name: SubscriptionFilter
nodes.business_intent: Is the recipient subscribed? Is the topic enabled? Has the recipient opted in to this channel?
nodes.extensibility: Chain of rules; add a rule without touching the others.

nodes.name: Email Channel
nodes.business_intent: Email delivery with templates and quiet hours.

nodes.name: EmailSender
nodes.business_intent: Email channel plugin: renders the template and hands it to the mail provider.

nodes.name: QuietHoursRule
nodes.business_intent: Holds non-urgent email during the recipient's quiet hours.

edges.purpose: Resolve the channel's limits when a message is dispatched.
Resolve the plugin class for a channel type.
Hand each routed message to its channel plugin.
Ask the rule whether the email may go out now.

utilities.name: render_template
utilities.signature: render_template(template: str, values: Mapping[str, str]) -> str
utilities.purpose: Render a message template with HTML-escaped values.

utilities.name: utc_now
utilities.purpose: Timezone-aware current UTC time; the single clock seam for tests.
